module purpose: Implements the RISC-V physical memory protection (PMP) unit: it holds per-region configuration and address registers written via CSR, decodes an access address and privilege (from pc_nxt or LSU address/privilege), computes per-region match and allow decisions, combines them into a fail vector, and raises a latched fault_o output when a protected access is denied and not in debug.

use-case flows.value: write per-region PMP configuration bytes (pmpcfg) via CSR writes
write per-region PMP address registers (pmpaddr) via CSR writes
evaluate an access: select acc_addr and acc_priv, compute region match and per-region allow, build fail vector and latch fault when denial occurs
CSR readback of configuration and address registers (cfg_rd / addr_rd) returning values on csr_o
lock bit (cfg_l) that freezes a region's configuration / address from CSR writes
reset-to-zero of stored PMP state (pmpcfg, pmpaddr, addr_mask) and clear of latched fault_o

conceptual assets.concept: Per-region PMP configuration bytes (pmpcfg): the 8-bit fields holding permissions (R/W/X), mode and the lock bit
conceptual assets.reasoning: The CSR write path and the CSR-fed pmpcfg registers implement the authority that the PMP check uses: csr_we_cfg detects CSR writes (lines 110-116) and the csr_pmpcfg process updates pmpcfg fields when pmpcfg_we is set and the lock bit is clear (lines 121-146). The match_gen and perm_gen processes consume those fields to compute match and allow (lines 301-314, 318-341). Corrupting pmpcfg would directly change allow/match outcomes, so integrity of pmpcfg is established. Map evidence: pmpcfg is a clocked register updated on clk_i (pmpcfg occurrence 4, CLOCKED_BY clk_i, line 129); CSR write data drives pmpcfg (ctrl_i.csr_wdata occurrence 2, SOURCES -> pmpcfg, line 129); the write enables are gated from CSR address/write (pmpcfg_we occurrence 3, SELECTED_BY ctrl_i.csr_addr, line 114). Readback leaves the block via csr_o (csr_o occurrence 2, DERIVES_FROM cfg_rd32, line 190).

conceptual assets.concept: Per-region PMP address registers (pmpaddr): the stored region address words used to define boundaries for matching
conceptual assets.reasoning: PMP address registers are written by CSR (csr_we_addr and csr_pmpaddr, lines 154-176) and are the operands used by the match comparators (cmp_na, cmp_ge, cmp_lt) and match_gen to decide which region applies (lines 285, 293-296, 301-314). Thus the integrity of pmpaddr is established: corrupting these registers changes which addresses match. Map evidence: pmpaddr is clocked storage (pmpaddr occurrence 3, CLOCKED_BY clk_i, line 173) driven from CSR write data (ctrl_i.csr_wdata occurrence 7, SOURCES -> pmpaddr, line 173) under CSR-address gating (pmpaddr_we occurrence 3, SELECTED_BY ctrl_i.csr_addr, line 158). Readback of addresses is emitted via csr_o (csr_o occurrence 3, DERIVES_FROM addr_rd, line 192).

conceptual assets.concept: Access request context (acc_addr and acc_priv): the address and privilege used to evaluate PMP rules for each access
conceptual assets.reasoning: The PMP checks operate on a selected access address and privilege: acc_addr is chosen between pc_nxt and addr_ls_i (line 244) and acc_priv between cpu_priv and lsu_priv (line 245). Those values are used by the comparator logic and perm_gen (lines 285-296, 318-341). Corrupting acc_addr or acc_priv would change match/allow outcomes; the RTL explicitly derives these values from input ports. Map evidence: acc_addr is computed from pc_nxt/addr_ls_i (acc_addr occurrence 2, DERIVES_FROM ctrl_i.pc_nxt / addr_ls_i, line 244) and is driven by ctrl_i.pc_nxt (ctrl_i.pc_nxt occurrence 2, SOURCES -> acc_addr, line 244) and addr_ls_i (addr_ls_i occurrence 2, SOURCES -> acc_addr, line 244). acc_priv is computed from cpu_priv or lsu_priv (acc_priv occurrence 2, DERIVES_FROM ctrl_i.cpu_priv / ctrl_i.lsu_priv, line 245) and those ports source it (ctrl_i.cpu_priv occurrence 2, SOURCES -> acc_priv, line 245; ctrl_i.lsu_priv occurrence 2, SOURCES -> acc_priv, line 245).

conceptual assets.concept: Per-region allow decision (allow): the computed permission bit that determines whether an access type and privilege are permitted by a region
conceptual assets.reasoning: The perm_gen process computes allow(r) from pmpcfg, acc_priv and the access type signals (lines 318-341). allow gates the fail vector (fail generation lines 351-355) so its correctness is required for the module to permit or deny accesses correctly. Map evidence: allow is computed from pmpcfg fields (allow occurrence 3, DERIVES_FROM pmpcfg, line 325) and is gated by the access-type and write-enable inputs (ctrl_i.lsu_mo_we occurrence 4, GATES -> allow, line 321; ctrl_i.lsu_rw occurrence 2, GATES -> allow, line 328). Corruption of allow would alter fail/fault outcomes (fail uses allow, line 354).

conceptual assets.concept: Latched PMP fault indicator (fault_o): the exported fault signal that reports a denied access (fail(0)) when not in CPU debug
conceptual assets.reasoning: The module reduces per-region allow/match results into a fail vector (lines 351-355) and latches the top-level fault into fault_o at the clock edge (fault_check, lines 358-364) as (not ctrl_i.cpu_debug) and fail(0) (line 363). The integrity of this output matters because it is the exported denial event. Map evidence: fault_o is a clocked output with reset (fault_o occurrence 3, CLOCKED_BY clk_i and RESET_BY rstn_i, lines 363 and 361) and its assignment is gated by cpu_debug and fail (fault_o occurrence 3, GATED_BY targets ctrl_i.cpu_debug and fail, line 363). fail is computed from allow/match (fail occurrence 3, DERIVES_FROM allow, line 354). cpu_debug gates the export (ctrl_i.cpu_debug occurrence 2, GATES -> fault_o, line 363).
